payload.core_mechanism_summary: Computes min swaps to sort 3-value array: counts frequencies, uses formula with slicing to get misplaced counts, or falls back to comparing sorted array to count inversions when only two values exist.
payload.rationale: The solution addresses sorting problem; the else branch uses Python's sorted(). Among limited sorting subtypes provided, sorting_custom_key is top-scored, though no custom key is used. Other subtypes are less applicable.
